capabilities: match notes by metadata, folders, tags, links, and frontmatter
render HTML templates with expressions, conditions, loops, and filters
embed Obsidian Bases data inside custom views
run optional trusted local JavaScript in templates
extras: First public development release (0.1.0) with optimization still ongoing; template JavaScript runs locally and should only be enabled for trusted templates; deeper implementation docs live in docs/CORE_V2.md.
problem: Obsidian views like Bases tables are static templates; there is no built-in way to build custom interfaces that react to vault changes and update only what changed.
summary: Programmable view builder that turns matching Markdown notes into reactive, custom-rendered views using rules, templates, expressions, and Bases data.
